title: Về Quê Cô Dâu
time_label: Chiều, một làng quê Nam Định (08:00–09:00)
location: Một ngôi nhà quê vùng đồng bằng sông Hồng ở Nam Định, buổi chiều: sân gạch, hàng cau, chum nước, gian thờ treo ảnh; 09.4 là con đường gạch giữa đồng lúa lúc hoàng hôn.
axis: Máy quay đặt giữa sân gạch nhìn vào gian thờ: cổng gạch bên trái, chum nước và hàng cau bên phải, ảnh cưới lớn treo trên tường gian thờ ở giữa; 09.4 máy lùi dần trước hai người trên đường gạch, đồng lúa hai bên.
props: Giỏ quà, phiếu đặt may viết tay (không chữ đọc được), ảnh cưới lớn trong khung treo trên tường gian thờ (cô dâu tóc nâu gợn sóng kẻ mắt xếch, chú rể tóc undercut ria mép mỏng), điện thoại của Thu (màn hình trống), gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
setting: A quiet village house in the Red River Delta in the afternoon: a yellow-walled single-storey house with a tiled roof, a brick-paved front yard with areca palms and a water jar, an open front room with a wooden altar and framed photos on the wall, soft green-gold light.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Số nhà, tên xóm khớp hết với phiếu may cô ấy ghi. Đúng nhà này rồi mẹ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ba tiếng ngồi xe khách, lưng mẹ gãy làm đôi rồi. Chẳng có gì thì con cõng mẹ về đấy.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Có đấy mẹ ạ. Trên tường gian thờ kia kìa.

clips.sfx: chickens clucking in a neighbour's yard, areca leaves rustling, a distant motorbike on a village road, a bamboo stick tapping on bricks

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at the brick gate, the wife in front with the slip, gentle push-in
85mm close-up of the old mother leaning on her bamboo stick, locked off
50mm medium shot of the wife from inside the open front room, the yard behind her, locked off
28mm wide shot from the front-room step onto the two women in the yard, slow drift

steps: @Thu steps in through the brick gate of a yellow-walled village house with a gift basket on her arm and is already speaking matter-of-factly, holding up a small handwritten slip with no readable writing beside the gatepost, while @BaNhan shuffles in behind her on her bamboo stick, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps talking, her eyes moving from the slip to the yellow wall of the house.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, nodding once toward the open front room.
@Thu keeps talking as she folds the slip into her blouse pocket.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, while @BaNhan stops beside her, catching her breath.
@BaNhan presses one hand to the small of her back and starts grumbling in a dry comic voice, her wrinkled face screwed up in mock pain.
@BaNhan keeps grumbling, rubbing her lower back with her knuckles.
@BaNhan keeps talking, glaring at the yellow house.
@BaNhan keeps complaining, jabbing her bamboo stick toward the house.
@BaNhan keeps going, tapping the stick on the bricks with each word.
@BaNhan finishes with a sniff and closes her mouth.
@Thu, hiding a smile, turns toward the open front room and answers quietly, lifting her chin at the wall inside.
@Thu keeps speaking softly, her eyes on the yellow wall inside, while @BaNhan follows her gaze, mouth closed.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, a knowing look in her eyes.
@BaNhan squints toward the front room and lifts a hand to shade her eyes, while @Thu waits beside her with the gift basket, both silent.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Cô dâu trông quen quen. Phải con bé váy đỏ lau nhà cho mẹ hôm nọ không?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vâng, đúng nó đấy mẹ. Còn chú rể đứng bên cạnh, mẹ nhìn kỹ xem.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ối giời, cậu luật sư cầm cặp ngược! Hai đứa nó cưới nhau rồi à?

clips.sfx: a slow wooden clock ticking, incense crackling softly, a rooster far off, a sharp intake of breath

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot from the side wall, the two women in profile gazing up at the framed wedding photo on the wall at frame left, locked off
85mm close-up of the wife looking up at the photo, locked off
40mm medium two-shot of the two women beside the altar, slow lateral slide

steps: @BaNhan stands beside @Thu beneath a large framed wedding photo on the yellow wall above a wooden altar, squints up at the bride and is already speaking, pointing her bamboo stick at the frame, while @Thu looks up with her mouth closed.

In the frame a bride with long wavy dark-brown hair and winged eyeliner in a white gown smiles beside a lean groom with a styled black undercut and a thin moustache, while @BaNhan keeps talking, leaning closer on her stick.
@BaNhan keeps talking, screwing up her eyes at the bride's wavy hair as incense smoke drifts across the glass.
@BaNhan keeps going, turning her head toward @Thu, eyebrows knitted.
@BaNhan finishes her question, closes her mouth and waits.
@Thu, eyes still on the photo, answers slowly and quietly.
@Thu keeps speaking low and steady, lifting her chin toward the groom in the frame.
@Thu keeps talking, her gaze fixed on the thin moustache in the photo.
@Thu keeps going slowly, her face perfectly calm.
@Thu keeps speaking, finishing in the same low voice.
@Thu closes her mouth as @BaNhan peers up at the groom's thin moustache, her jaw drops, and she blurts out a fast reply.
@BaNhan keeps talking fast, jabbing her stick toward the groom, while @Thu stands beside her with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps going, flapping a hand at the photo, her eyebrows flying up.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, turning to stare at @Thu.
@Thu keeps her eyes on the wedding photo, lips pressed together, while @BaNhan waits beside her with her eyebrows high, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ba năm rồi mẹ ạ. Cỗ bày kín sân, cả xóm ai cũng biết.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thế thì con chụp ngay lại đi, mang về cho thằng Tùng nó sáng mắt ra.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Chưa được đâu mẹ. Bây giờ anh ấy đang mù, ảnh gì cũng bảo là ảnh ghép.

clips.sfx: a soft phone camera click, incense crackling, chickens clucking outside, wind in the areca palms

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot of the two women beside the altar, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the old mother, incense smoke behind her, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the old mother onto the wife
50mm medium profile shot of the wife lifting the phone toward the photo on the wall, slow push-in

steps: @Thu, still looking up at the wedding photo, is already speaking quietly and with certainty, while @BaNhan stands beside her leaning on her bamboo stick, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, her hands folded over the handle of the gift basket.
@Thu keeps talking, glancing out toward the brick yard and the neighbouring houses beyond the gate.
@Thu finishes, turning back to the photo.
@Thu closes her mouth as @BaNhan nods sharply at the photo and starts speaking briskly, flapping a hand toward @Thu's blouse pocket.
@BaNhan keeps talking briskly, jabbing a bony finger up at the frame.
@BaNhan keeps going, tapping her bamboo stick on the tiles for emphasis.
@BaNhan keeps talking, miming taking a picture with her thin old hands.
@BaNhan finishes, eyebrows raised, nodding firmly.
@BaNhan closes her mouth as @Thu takes out a phone with a glowing blank screen and starts answering slowly and thoughtfully.
@Thu keeps speaking, the glowing blank screen lighting her chin, while @BaNhan listens with her back to the camera, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps talking in a low cool voice, turning the phone over in her fingers.
@Thu raises the phone toward the wedding photo on the wall as she keeps speaking.
@Thu finishes, her eyes on the photo, a small cold smile on her lips.
@Thu closes her mouth and quietly takes one picture of the wedding photo, while @BaNhan beside her purses her lips and gives a slow approving nod, both silent.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Hàng xóm bảo năm nào con bé cũng về khoe vớ được đại gia. Con còn đợi đến bao giờ?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Đến đúng hôm anh ấy tự tay trao sính lễ cho vợ người ta, mẹ ạ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Hay đấy. Lúc ấy thì mẹ phải ngồi hàng đầu mà xem.

clips.setting: A narrow brick lane through a Red River Delta village at sunset: bamboo hedges, a pond with ducks, rice fields glowing gold beyond the low houses.
clips.sfx: ducks quacking on the pond, bamboo creaking in the evening breeze, crickets starting up, a bamboo stick tapping on bricks

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot of the two women walking toward the camera down the brick lane, slow dolly back
85mm close-up of the wife against the golden rice fields, locked off
50mm medium shot of the old mother on the lane, the sunset behind her, slow push-in
28mm wide shot of the two women on the brick lane, the rice fields glowing beyond them, locked off

steps: @BaNhan and @Thu walk slowly up a narrow brick lane between bamboo hedges toward the camera at sunset; @BaNhan is already speaking with a gossipy tilt of her head, while @Thu carries the empty gift basket with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps talking, her bamboo stick tapping the bricks, nodding back toward the village.
@BaNhan keeps going, lowering her voice as if sharing a secret, a crooked grin on her face.
@BaNhan turns her face up to @Thu and keeps speaking, her grin gone and her eyes sharp.
@BaNhan keeps talking, ending on a pointed question.
@BaNhan closes her mouth; @Thu stops walking, looks out over the golden rice fields and answers slowly and coldly.
@Thu keeps speaking very quietly, the sunset light on her face, her eyes unblinking.
@Thu keeps talking, her fingers tightening on the basket handle.
@Thu keeps speaking in the same low voice, her jaw set.
@Thu keeps going, finishing as ducks glide across a still pond behind her.
@Thu closes her mouth; @BaNhan breaks into a slow sly smile and answers with a dry chuckle.
@BaNhan keeps talking, relishing it, wagging one finger.
@BaNhan keeps going, chuckling, her eyes twinkling.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, nodding to herself.
@BaNhan and @Thu walk on side by side down the golden lane, both silent.

title: Bé Na Theo Bố
time_label: Cuối tuần, trước tiệm may rồi đêm trong tiệm (09:00–10:00)
location: Vỉa hè trước tiệm may áo dài phố Hàng Gai (10.1), trong tiệm ban ngày (10.2) và trong tiệm ban đêm (10.3–10.4).
axis: 10.1 máy đặt trên vỉa hè ngang tầm trẻ con, cửa kính tiệm bên trái, xe sang đen bên phải. Trong tiệm: máy đặt sau bàn cắt nhìn ra cửa kính, máy may bên trái, cầu thang trong tiệm phía sau; ban đêm cửa cuốn kéo nửa chừng, ma-nơ-canh mặc áo cưới đang may cạnh máy may.
props: Máy tính bảng màu hồng (màn hình trống), ba lô nhỏ và áo khoác của Na, áo dài cưới đỏ thêu phượng vàng đang may trên ma-nơ-canh, đèn bàn, thước dây vàng, ghế đẩu.
setting: Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop on an old-quarter silk street by day: bolts of jewel-toned silk stacked on wooden shelves to the ceiling, two headless dress forms in half-finished áo dài, an old black sewing machine on a worn wooden table, a tall standing fitting mirror, a long cutting table with tailor's chalk and paper patterns, a small brass bell above the glass door, soft daylight from the street.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Quà của cô đây, máy tính bảng mới tinh. Cuối tuần sang nhà bố, có bể bơi trên tầng thượng nhé.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Thật ạ? Con mang cả phao vịt sang bơi được không cô? Con bơi giỏi lắm!

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Mang gì cũng được. Ở tiệm may suốt ngày với mẹ, chán lắm nhỉ?

clips.setting: The pavement outside Thu's áo dài tailor shop on an old-quarter silk street by day: a glass shop door, potted plants, parked motorbikes, a black luxury sedan with no badge at the curb.
clips.sfx: motorbikes buzzing past, a car engine idling softly, sparrows chirping in the potted plants, a shop bell jingling faintly

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at child height, the woman crouching before the girl by the shop door, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the girl hugging the pink tablet, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the girl onto the woman
35mm wide shot along the pavement outside the tailor shop, locked off

steps: On the sunny pavement outside the tailor shop, @Vy crouches in front of @Na beside the potted plants, holds out a pink tablet with a glowing blank screen and is already speaking in a honeyed voice, while @Na clutches her backpack straps, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking sweetly, tilting the glowing tablet toward @Na.
@Vy keeps going, pointing up toward the rooftops with a wide smile.
@Vy keeps talking as she sets the pink tablet into @Na's small hands.
@Vy keeps speaking, glancing at a black luxury sedan with no badge idling at the curb.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, smiling, while @Na hugs the tablet to her chest.
@Na bounces on her toes and asks a fast excited question, her bright eyes wide.
@Na keeps talking excitedly, pigtails bobbing.
@Na keeps going, miming a swimming stroke with one arm, the tablet under the other.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, grinning down at the glowing screen.
@Vy answers with a sweet smile, tilting her head toward the shop's glass door.
@Vy keeps speaking softly, her eyes flicking to the shop and back.
@Vy keeps talking, her voice sugary, one eyebrow lifting slyly.
@Vy finishes, closes her mouth and straightens up.
@Vy's smile cools into a smirk as she glances at the shop's glass door, while @Na beams down at the glowing screen, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, bố cho con sang chơi hai hôm cơ! Mẹ cho con đi nhé, đi mà!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ừ, con đi đi. Nhớ mang áo khoác, trên cao gió lạnh lắm đấy. Mẹ gấp sẵn cho rồi.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ không giận ạ? Con cứ tưởng mẹ không cho, con còn định khóc cơ.

clips.sfx: the brass door bell jingling, small running footsteps, a zip closing, street traffic muffled behind the glass

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot following the girl from the glass door to the cutting table
85mm close-up of the mother at the cutting table, locked off
40mm medium two-shot across the cutting table, slow drift
28mm wide shot of the shop from the silk shelves, locked off

steps: The brass bell jingles as @Na bursts in through the glass door of the tailor shop with the pink tablet under her arm and is already speaking fast and breathlessly.
@Na keeps talking, hopping toward the cutting table with her hands clasped as if pleading.
@Na keeps going, bouncing on her toes, eyes huge.
@Na keeps pleading, leaning over the edge of the long cutting table.
@Na closes her mouth; @Thu, chalk in hand at the cutting table, looks up and begins to answer slowly with a soft smile.
@Thu keeps speaking gently as she sets the chalk down and picks up a small folded jacket.
@Thu keeps talking, folding the small jacket carefully, her smile steady.
@Thu keeps going slowly, tucking the folded jacket into an open school backpack on the table.
@Thu keeps speaking, patting the backpack flat.
@Thu keeps talking, finishing with a small nod, her eyes glistening.
@Thu closes her mouth; @Na blinks up at her and asks a quick surprised question, tilting her head.
@Na keeps talking, her face lighting up, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Na keeps going, giggling, rubbing one eye in mock tears.
@Na finishes, closes her mouth and twirls toward the door hugging the tablet.
@Thu zips the backpack in silence, blinking hard, her eyes rimmed red behind the smile.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Con để cái Na sang ở với con hồ ly ấy thật à? Mẹ chịu con đấy.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Cấm thì nó càng thèm, mẹ ạ. Cứ để nó sang, tự nhìn xem người lớn thật thế nào.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Nói thì cứng lắm, mà mắt con đỏ hoe từ nãy rồi kìa.

clips.setting: Night in Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop: the steel shutter half down, a single warm desk lamp over the old black sewing machine, bolts of silk fading into shadow on the shelves, two headless dress forms, a long cutting table with paper patterns.
clips.sfx: the slow clatter of the treadle sewing machine, the desk lamp humming, a motorbike passing beyond the half-closed shutter, slippers on wooden stairs

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the old mother at the foot of the narrow inner staircase, locked off
85mm close-up of the wife at the sewing machine in the lamplight, locked off
40mm medium two-shot of the two women at the sewing machine, slow push-in

steps: Night in the tailor shop: @BaNhan comes down the narrow inner staircase in her cardigan, one hand on the rail, and is already speaking in a low disapproving voice, her eyes on the lamplit sewing machine across the room.
@BaNhan keeps talking as she reaches the bottom step, her bamboo stick tapping the tiles.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, shaking her head slowly.
@BaNhan keeps going, pointing her stick toward a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix on a headless dress form.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, waiting at the foot of the stairs.
@Thu stops the treadle under the single warm desk lamp and answers without turning round, her eyes glistening.
@Thu keeps speaking steadily, the red silk motionless under her hands.
@Thu keeps talking, her lips trembling once before she steadies them.
@Thu keeps going quietly, smoothing the red silk with both palms.
@Thu keeps speaking, finishing in a near whisper.
@Thu closes her mouth; @BaNhan lowers herself onto a stool beside her, peers at her face and adds a dry remark.
@BaNhan keeps talking dryly, nodding at @Thu's red eyes, while @Thu keeps her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, her voice softening.
@BaNhan keeps going, finishing with a small sigh.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and watches @Thu, while @Thu blinks fast in the lamplight, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Con có khóc đâu mẹ. Lụa đỏ nhiều bụi lắm, bay vào mắt đấy ạ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ừ, bụi thì lau đi. Nước mắt mà rơi vào áo của nó thì phí lụa.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ đừng lo. Áo này con may khít, ai mặc cũng phải đứng thật thẳng.

clips.setting: Night in Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop: the steel shutter half down, a single warm desk lamp over the old black sewing machine, bolts of silk fading into shadow on the shelves, two headless dress forms, a long cutting table with paper patterns.
clips.sfx: the desk lamp humming, a soft sniff, silk rustling under fingertips, the night street quiet beyond the shutter

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot of the two women at the sewing machine, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the old mother on the stool, lamplight on her wrinkles, locked off
35mm medium two-shot beside the dress form, the old mother on her stool at frame left, locked off
85mm close-up of the wife at the dress form, slow push-in

steps: @Thu, a single tear sliding down her cheek, lets out a tiny wet laugh and is already speaking slowly, waving a hand near her eyes, while @BaNhan on the stool beside her watches with her mouth closed.
@Thu keeps speaking, rubbing one eye with the back of her wrist.
@Thu keeps talking, nodding at the heap of red silk as if blaming the dust.
@Thu keeps going, sniffing once.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, looking down at the silk.
@BaNhan speaks gruffly and tenderly, nodding at the red silk wedding áo dài on the dress form.
@BaNhan keeps talking, her old eyes soft, one bony finger miming a wipe under her own eye.
@BaNhan keeps going, pursing her lips in mock sternness.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, wagging the finger at the precious silk.
@BaNhan closes her mouth; @Thu dabs the tear away with a fingertip, stands and answers slowly.
@Thu keeps speaking as she runs the yellow measuring tape around the narrow waist of the red áo dài on the dress form.
@Thu keeps talking warmly, pulling the tape snug, while @BaNhan listens on the stool with her mouth closed.
@Thu keeps speaking, her hand resting on the waist seam.
@Thu keeps going, smoothing the gold phoenix on the red silk with her palm, and finishes with a small smile.
@Thu closes her mouth and keeps smoothing the gold phoenix with a quiet, certain look, silent.

title: Bể Bơi Trên Tầng Thượng
time_label: Thứ bảy, căn hộ của Vy (10:00–11:00)
location: Căn hộ cao cấp của Vy trên cao nhìn xuống Hà Nội ban ngày (11.1–11.3); tiệm may của Thu ban đêm (11.4).
axis: Máy đặt cạnh cửa kính nhìn vào phòng khách: sofa da trắng ở giữa, đảo bếp đá bên trái, cửa ra vào bên phải; 11.4 trong tiệm may đêm, máy ngang tầm trẻ con cạnh máy may nhìn ra cửa cuốn.
props: Bức vẽ bút sáp cả nhà (không chữ), vệt bút sáp đỏ trên sofa da trắng, hộp bút sáp, điện thoại của Vy và của Tùng (màn hình trống), ba lô của Na.
setting: A glossy luxury apartment high above Hà Nội by day: floor-to-ceiling windows over the city with a rooftop pool glinting below, a white leather sofa, a marble kitchen island, cold bright daylight.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Cô ơi, con vẽ cả nhà mình. Bố, mẹ, bà nội, với con. Con tặng cô đấy.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Vẽ thì vẽ ra giấy! Bôi lên ghế da của cô à? Cái ghế này đắt hơn cả tiệm may của mẹ cháu đấy!

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Con xin lỗi cô, con không cố ý đâu ạ.

clips.sfx: the hum of air conditioning, crayons rolling on a glass table, a tissue squeaking on leather, faint city traffic far below

shots.camera: 40mm medium shot from the window side of the girl kneeling on the rug by the white leather sofa, the marble kitchen island behind her, locked off
85mm close-up of the young woman, cold daylight on her face, locked off
40mm medium two-shot by the white leather sofa, slow drift

steps: In the glossy apartment by day, @Na kneels on the pale rug by the white leather sofa, holds up a crayon drawing of four smiling stick figures with no writing and is already speaking earnestly.
@Na keeps talking proudly, pointing to each stick figure in turn.
@Na keeps speaking, turning the drawing toward the marble kitchen island with a hopeful smile.
@Na keeps going, holding the drawing up high in both hands; a fresh red crayon streak shows on one white cushion beside her.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth as @Vy walks in from the kitchen island behind her.
@Vy spots the red streak on the white leather, her eyes flaring, and starts speaking fast and cold, pointing at it.
@Vy keeps talking sharply, her red lips tight, her finger jabbing toward the cushion.
@Vy keeps going, her voice rising, her winged eyes narrowing.
@Vy keeps speaking coldly, glancing from the streak down at the girl.
@Vy keeps talking as she pulls a tissue from a box on the arm of the sofa.
@Vy closes her mouth and scrubs at the red streak; @Na slowly lowers the drawing against her chest and says a small apology, her eyes on the rug.
@Na keeps speaking in a small voice, lips trembling, while @Vy scrubs the leather with her mouth closed.
@Na keeps going, her eyes still on the rug.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, sitting back on her heels.
@Vy keeps scrubbing the leather without looking at @Na, her face cold, while @Na hugs the drawing, eyes wet, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Con bé bướng lắm anh ạ. Xong việc này là em cho nó về với mẹ nó. Em chẳng muốn trông nó nữa.
turns.tone: irritated and low, on the phone

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Cô ấy không thích con rồi. Con chỉ muốn về với mẹ thôi.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Thôi em cúp đây, lão ấy sắp về rồi. Tối mình nói tiếp.
turns.tone: suddenly brisk, eyes on the door

clips.sfx: a phone buzzing, the hum of air conditioning, long fingernails tapping on glass, paper crinkling

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot by the white leather sofa, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the girl on the white sofa, slow push-in
50mm medium shot of the young woman at the floor-to-ceiling window, the city bright behind her, locked off

steps: A phone with a glowing blank screen at her ear, @Vy straightens up from the sofa and is already speaking fast and low into it with an irritated roll of her eyes, while @Na kneels by the sofa with her drawing, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, turning her back on the sofa, her lips pressed thin.
@Vy keeps going, flicking a glance back over her shoulder toward @Na.
@Vy keeps speaking low and fast, rolling her eyes, as she walks toward the floor-to-ceiling window.
@Vy keeps talking, her free hand on her hip, her voice flat and cold.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, listening to the phone, her back to the room.
On the white sofa @Na, who has heard every word, begins to whisper slowly to herself, her eyes lowered.
@Na keeps whispering, holding her crayon drawing close.
@Na keeps whispering, her eyes on the drawing.
@Na whispers the last words and closes her mouth, looking quietly toward the door.

title: Chính Thất Đồng Ý Ly Hôn

@Tung stares at the red box, sweat beading on his temple, while @Thu keeps her hand on the gold bow, both silent.

title: Món Quà Cưới
location: Sảnh tiệc khách sạn trang hoàng cho lễ ăn hỏi, buổi tối.
axis: Như cảnh 16: máy giữa lối đi nhìn lên sân khấu, cổng hoa ở giữa, bàn khay sính lễ bên phải sân khấu, bàn đầu của bố mẹ cô dâu bên trái gần sân khấu.
props: Hộp quà đỏ lớn thắt nơ vàng, ảnh cưới lớn trong khung (cô dâu tóc nâu gợn sóng kẻ mắt xếch, chú rể tóc undercut ria mép mỏng), khay sính lễ, cặp tài liệu da đen, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
setting: A lavish hotel banquet hall set for an engagement ceremony in the evening: round tables with white cloths and red roses, a low stage with a flower arch and a gold heart backdrop with no letters, trays of betrothal gifts covered in red cloth, crystal chandeliers, warm golden light.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Quà của chị đây. Ảnh cưới lần trước của em, chị xin từ bàn thờ nhà em ở Nam Định.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Ảnh ghép! Chị cắt ghép để bôi nhọ em! Mọi người đừng ai tin bà ta!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ghép hay không, em hỏi cậu luật sư cầm cặp ngược kia xem.

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.sfx: satin ribbon sliding loose, a box lid lifting, chandelier crystals tinkling, a sudden hush across the hall

steps: At the white-clothed gift table, @Thu unties the gold ribbon of a large red gift box, lifts the lid and is already speaking slowly and clearly, while @Vy stands beside the table with her mouth closed.

@Thu raises from the box a large framed wedding photo of a young couple: a bride with long wavy dark-brown hair and winged eyeliner in a white gown beside a lean groom with a styled black undercut and a thin moustache, and keeps speaking.
@Thu keeps talking clearly, holding the framed photo steady at chest height toward the hall.
@Thu keeps speaking, every word placed, her calm eyes on the bride.
@Thu keeps going, tilting the frame a little so the chandelier light falls on the glass.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, her face calm above the gilded frame.
@Vy, the colour draining from her face, starts to speak fast and shrill, flapping both hands at the photo without touching it.
@Vy keeps talking shrilly, her eyes darting toward the hall.
@Vy keeps going, shaking her head so the red khăn vấn trembles.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, breathing hard.
@Thu answers slowly and coolly, holding the framed photo perfectly still.
@Thu keeps speaking, tilting her head toward the far end of the gift table.
@Thu keeps talking, unbothered, her eyes never leaving the bride.
@Thu keeps going, finishing with a small polite nod.
@Thu closes her mouth and holds the framed photo still, while @Vy stares at it, breathing hard, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Chú rể trong ảnh... là cậu à? Cậu bảo cậu là anh họ của Vy cơ mà?

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Anh nghe em giải thích! Ảnh ấy chụp đóng phim thôi, phim quảng cáo áo cưới ấy mà, anh tin em!

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thế nhẫn trên tay cậu cũng là đạo cụ à?

clips.sfx: a sudden hush in the hall, a chair scraping, the leather folder creaking in tight fingers, a dry swallow

steps: A large framed wedding photo of a bride in a white gown beside a lean groom with a styled black undercut and a thin moustache stands among the betrothal trays; @Tung looks from the groom in the frame to @Khai and is already speaking slowly in a hollow voice, while @Khai holds the black leather folder tight, mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking, his voice hollow, pointing a limp finger at the photo.
@Tung keeps going, his face slack, his eyes moving between the photo and the young man.
@Tung keeps speaking, his voice dropping.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, staring at @Khai.
@Khai takes one step back, raising both palms, a plain gold wedding ring glinting on his finger, and answers fast with a forced laugh.
@Khai keeps talking, his sly half-smile slipping.
@Khai keeps going, laughing too loudly, sweat on his upper lip.
@Khai keeps speaking, waving his raised palms.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, palms still raised.
@Tung's eyes drop to the plain gold wedding ring on @Khai's raised hand and he asks a short flat question.
@Tung keeps speaking numbly, his eyes fixed on the ring.
@Tung keeps talking, his voice going flat.
@Tung closes his mouth as @Khai slowly lowers his ringed hand behind his back.
@Tung keeps staring at the hidden hand, while @Khai's forced smile freezes, both silent.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Phim gì mà treo ảnh trên bàn thờ nhà gái những ba năm nay? Phim ấy chiếu dài quá nhỉ.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mẹ... mẹ biết chuyện này từ lâu rồi à?

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Từ hôm về quê nó. Cả làng biết, chỉ mỗi anh là không biết. Anh còn mải đếm tiền sính lễ.

steps: At the front banquet table under the chandeliers, @BaNhan rises from her chair, leaning on her carved bamboo walking stick, and is already speaking sharply and clearly, her eyes fixed on her son.
@BaNhan keeps talking, dry and cutting.
@BaNhan keeps going, lifting her stick a little toward the framed photo on the gift table.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, one eyebrow raised.
@BaNhan keeps talking, with a short mocking sniff.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, both hands back on the stick.
@Tung, his face drained of colour, asks slowly in a hollow voice.
@Tung keeps speaking, ashen, his lips barely moving.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, swallowing hard.
@BaNhan taps her stick once on the floor and answers fast and briskly.
@BaNhan keeps talking without a pause, her eyebrows raised.
@BaNhan keeps going, rubbing her thumb and fingers together as if counting banknotes.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, giving a small sharp nod.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, both hands folded on top of her stick.
@BaNhan looks back at him steadily, while @Tung sways slightly in the foreground, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Còn ông bà ngồi bàn đầu là diễn viên thuê, một triệu một buổi. Em hỏi giá rồi.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Diễn viên? Tôi chuyển cho chúng nó năm tỷ rồi! Năm tỷ đấy, cô có biết không?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Biết chứ. Tiền ấy anh tự tay chuyển mà. Anh mời nhầm hai họ rồi.

@Tung keeps going, holding up one hand with all his fingers spread.
